The conductor gate report's root-cause finding (§6) traces this block to PP28's own KBLI-2020-vintage lampiran row for digit-string 66292 ('Aktivitas Pemeringkat Usaha Mikro, Kecil, Menengah dan Koperasi') — a vintage-blind digit-string join matched this row's kewajiban onto 2025-66292 (whose real scope is insurance/pension supervision) instead of the activity's TRUE 2025 home; corroborated this session by direct read of the canonical dataset, whose current 66198 record ('Pemeringkatan Usaha Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, dan Koperasi') carries kbli_2020_source='66292' and itself serves the identical koperasi block verbatim, confirming 66198 (untouched by this cure) is the correct home. The other 3 payload_cross_contamination codes (68125, 68127, 68129) sit inside the report's independently-verified seven-child 2020-68111 crosswalk fan ({68111, 68112, 68123, 68125, 68126, 68127, 68129}, render lampiran5_p223-223.png / BPS Lampiran 5 printed p.209) and carry THREE further distinct contamination signatures verified this session: a generic hygiene-sanitation certification block (68125's first row, byte-identical to 68123/68126 below), an industrial-zone land-use/masterplan block (68125's second row and all of 68127), and a property-brokerage licensing block (68129) — none topically connected to shopping-center management, office-building management, or other non-residential real-estate activity respectively. mapping_metadata_false (2: 68123, 68126) — the declared crosswalk narrative is itself false: both cite a plausible title-similarity 2020 parent (68130 'Kawasan Industri' for 68123; 52101 'Pergudangan' for 68126) that the SAME fan render directly contradicts — the fan establishes both codes' TRUE 2020 ancestor as 68111, and this session additionally corroborates 68130's real 2025 child is 68122 (whose own canonical kbli_2020_source='68130' record confirms the citation belongs there, not at 68123). Both also carry the same hygiene-sanitation contamination signature as 68125's first row (byte-identical, verified this session). source_absent_in_vault (1: 70100) — the crosswalk mapping itself reads clean 1:1 (the lane's own read, and one of the report's three true D1-clean-vs-D5-problem divergences alongside 66211/66224), but the self-cited pp28_sources=['70100'] cannot be independently confirmed against the pinned vault sources; an honest source-absent gap (F12: never 'not published', only 'not retrievable/verifiable from our sources'), no alternate parent asserted. All 13 in the v2 closed registry (m3, breach=false); m1 problem-bit agreement 10/13=0.769 (same-family runner-proxy breach declared, consistent with Lots 3-4); m2 certification rate 0.000 (0/13, declared-breach, same disease band held for five consecutive lots); m4 avg 200574/max 228839 (66192) tokens/dossier, both under the 400000 ceiling.
